description: This file defines data structures, enums, and inline functions for emitting formatted output in JSON or table formats, used internally within jemalloc for debugging or reporting purposes.

methods.name: emitter_printf
methods.description: Internal inline function to write formatted strings to the emitter's output.

methods.name: emitter_gen_fmt
methods.description: Generates a format string based on justification and width.

methods.name: emitter_print_value
methods.description: Prints a value of a specific type in the appropriate format.

methods.name: emitter_nest_inc
methods.description: Increments nesting depth for JSON output.

methods.name: emitter_nest_dec
methods.description: Decrements nesting depth for JSON output.

methods.name: emitter_indent
methods.description: Outputs indentation based on nesting depth.

methods.name: emitter_json_key_prefix
methods.description: Outputs comma and newline before a JSON key if needed.

methods.name: emitter_init
methods.description: Initializes an emitter object with output format and callback.

methods.name: emitter_json_key
methods.description: Outputs a JSON key.

methods.name: emitter_json_value
methods.description: Outputs a JSON value of a given type.

methods.name: emitter_json_kv
methods.description: Outputs a JSON key-value pair.

methods.name: emitter_json_array_begin
methods.description: Begins a JSON array.

methods.name: emitter_json_array_kv_begin
methods.description: Begins a JSON array with a key.

methods.name: emitter_json_array_end
methods.description: Ends a JSON array.

methods.name: emitter_json_object_begin
methods.description: Begins a JSON object.

methods.name: emitter_json_object_kv_begin
methods.description: Begins a JSON object with a key.

methods.name: emitter_json_object_end
methods.description: Ends a JSON object.

methods.name: emitter_table_dict_begin
methods.description: Begins a table dictionary section.

methods.name: emitter_table_dict_end
methods.description: Ends a table dictionary section.

methods.name: emitter_table_kv_note
methods.description: Outputs a key-value pair with an optional note in table format.

methods.name: emitter_table_kv
methods.description: Outputs a key-value pair in table format.

methods.name: emitter_table_row
methods.description: Outputs a row in table format.

methods.name: emitter_row_init
methods.description: Initializes a table row.

methods.name: emitter_col_init
methods.description: Initializes a table column.

methods.name: emitter_kv_note
methods.description: Emits a key-value pair in JSON or table format with optional note.

methods.name: emitter_kv
methods.description: Emits a key-value pair in JSON or table format.

methods.name: emitter_dict_begin
methods.description: Begins a dictionary section in JSON or table.

methods.name: emitter_dict_end
methods.description: Ends a dictionary section in JSON or table.

methods.name: emitter_begin
methods.description: Starts the JSON object or initializes table output.

methods.name: emitter_end
methods.description: Ends the JSON object.
